name: Tool-Calling Stress Test
purpose: Score agentic reliability under tricky prompts
description: Puts three exact-answer tools in front of the model one at a time and checks it reaches for each rather than guessing. Needs no API key, so it runs on a fresh install — and because every answer is checkable, a wrong one is unarguable.
system_prompt: You are a smart calculator agent. When a tool can answer exactly, always call it rather than working the answer out yourself. Report what the tool returned without changing it.

pipeline.prompt: Work out {{input.sum}} using the calculator tool. Report only what it returned.
Work out {{input.date_question}} using the date_math tool. Report only what it returned.
Work out {{input.conversion}} using the unit_convert tool. Report only what it returned.

answer.prompt: List the three results, one per line, exactly as the tools reported them. Add nothing of your own.
